data.answer: Yes, Nimbus Labs holds a SOC 2 Type II report covering the Nimbus Ledger Sync platform. The audit period ran from 1 January 2026 to 30 June 2026.
The independent firm that performed the SOC 2 audit is Harlow & Pike LLP.
The Trust Services Criteria included in the SOC 2 scope were Security (common criteria), Availability, and Confidentiality.

The auditor noted two exceptions: one quarterly access review was completed 6 days after the due date in Q1 2026, and one terminated contractor retained read-only access to a staging tool for 2 days after their contract ended. Both exceptions were remediated and closed before the report was issued.
The full report is available to customers and prospects under a signed NDA. Requests can be sent to security@nimbuslabs.example and are answered within 3 business days.
Yes, customer administrators can connect their own SAML 2.0 identity provider to Nimbus Ledger Sync.
Yes, multi-factor authentication is mandatory for every employee account with no exceptions.
An external penetration test is performed once a year by CertiNova.
The most recent penetration test in March 2026 found no critical issues and two medium issues, both of which were fixed within 21 days.
Authenticated vulnerability scans of production run weekly.
